configuration.image_preprocessing: decode to RGB; preserve aspect ratio; if needed downscale the long edge to 960 pixels with deterministic Lanczos resampling; no upscaling, adaptive thresholding, deskew, label-guided crop, or semantic post-processing
configuration.title_extraction: production-title-candidates-python-parity/v1; page order, top-left geometry, prominence and adjacent groups of at most three OCR lines; metadata blind
configuration.title_normalization: NFKC, casefold, Unicode dash/quote folding, non-alphanumeric-to-space, whitespace collapse

quality_gate.exact_title_definition: OCR title equals poster ground-truth title after frozen normalization; fuzzy or review results excluded
quality_gate.cer_wer_normalization: NFKC plus whitespace collapse only; punctuation and case preserved
quality_gate.arithmetic: rates and means recomputed from per-case raw values

operational_gate.basis: 16 GiB functional-minimum host, existing 90-second provider timeout, single-worker queue and approximately 100+ annual projects
